data.name: Hujaimah
data.gender_notes: Hujaimah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The one whom Allah has given, a bestowal from God. The name Hujaimah carries the meaning “God's Gift” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Hujaimah usually hope their child will grow to embody god's gift and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A reminder of Allah's blessings and gifts.
data.etymology: Hujaimah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's Gift.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hujaimah total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
